name: product-builder
description: Turn a bootstrapped project into a working product by writing the PRD and building features. Requires a project bootstrapped by project-bootstrapper.

interface.shortDescription: Build features from a bootstrapped project.
interface.longDescription: Drives the product development lifecycle on a bootstrapped project: writes the PRD by interviewing the user about features and user flows, plans and implements features one by one, verifies each against acceptance criteria, and runs E2E tests. Requires a project bootstrapped by project-bootstrapper (scaffold, database, auth, etc. already wired).
defaultPrompt: Write the PRD and build the product features.
Plan and implement the next feature.
